gaps.explanation: p16 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints seven enterprise columns (Golf, Sanitation, Solid Waste Disposal Facility, Sanitary Sewer, Water, Storm Water, Airport); none is in detail[] (Internal Service Funds column not used). JSON receipts = Sales 32,628,173 + Miscellaneous 367,619 + Intergovernmental 7,894,695 + Investment earnings 453,633 + Gains on disposal 91,350 = 41,435,470. By column: Golf 1,322,580 + 3,867 + 13,250 = 1,339,697; Sanitation 5,277,129 + 45,911 = 5,323,040; Solid Waste 1,869,862 + 47,926 + 163,446 + 69,900 = 2,151,134; Sanitary Sewer 9,250,338 + 21,095 + 111,111 = 9,382,544; Water 10,711,120 + 211,444 + 97,899 + 8,200 = 11,028,663; Storm Water 421,839 + 18,392 = 440,231; Airport 3,775,305 + 131,213 + 7,846,769 + 16,874 = 11,770,161. Sum 41,435,470 = statement total.
